lastCompletedStory.title: Wire operator-decision moments to the file-based gate; keep AskUserQuestion disallowed

nextStoryContext: US-005 is documentation-only, per ADR-0043 and the CAM-52 issue spec (S5 is 'wire to the EXISTING gate', no new mechanism): the plan-approval gate (src/supervisor/plan-approval-gate.ts, makePlanApprovalResolver) and the ambiguity/blocker paths (implementer BLOCKED_AMBIGUITY exit, planner non-convergence via plan-escalation.ts) were already shipped; nothing there needed code changes. Added a new 'Operator-decision routing (ADR-0041, ADR-0043)' paragraph to .claude/commands/cam-review.md (right after the 'Relationship to the autonomous sidecar review pass' paragraph, before the Steps 0-5 divider) naming all three operator-decision moments (scope approval, ambiguity/blocker, review product-decision triage) and stating they route to the file-based gate (.claude/.cam-gate.json / cam-gate.schema.json, resolved via `cam decide <option>`, ADR-0041), never AskUserQuestion (ADR-0043). Also extended the existing Step 4 rubric-guardrails demotion bullet ('demote a CRITICAL needing a product decision to New cam issue') with one sentence naming the file-based gate as the escalation channel for that product decision. templates/commands/cam-review.md mirrors byte-for-byte (verified via diff -rq .claude/commands templates/commands); src/vendor/_generated.ts regenerated (bun run embed-vendor) and embed-vendor:check is clean. Did NOT touch subagent-planner.md, subagent-reviewer.md, or subagent-orchestrator.md: AskUserQuestion is already listed under disallowedTools in all three (verified via grep, unchanged) and none of US-005's acceptance-criteria oracles require editing them -- editing subagent-planner.md would have been scope creep beyond what the oracles verify. Pure markdown-prompt story: no external library was exercised, officialDocsValidated records no_external_lib_touched.
